about: The hare's walk: four poses of the body's own Walk (a slow lope made from its bound), side-on, down and up, at a browsing pace of 1000 ms a tile (a placeholder inside the pose-rate cap: a stride of 9 to 12 px across the views, drawn in four poses, holds its feet only up to about 65 px/s). The foot-slide limit is the wolf's 2 px for a quadruped's four-pose loop. Four poses a loop, as the owner picked for the wolf (DECISIONS 2026-10-29).
